title: The Existence and Attributes of God
author: Stephen Charnock
recommended_use: A major classic work on the doctrine of God; best for pastors teachers and serious students studying God's attributes.

title: Human Nature in Its Fourfold State
author: Thomas Boston
recommended_use: A classic doctrinal work on man's state before and after the fall and redemption; useful for doctrine and preaching preparation.

title: The Method of Grace
author: John Flavel
recommended_use: A Puritan-era treatment of the Spirit's application of redemption; useful for devotional doctrine and pastoral study.

title: The Gospel Worthy of All Acceptation
author: Andrew Fuller
recommended_use: A key Baptist work on gospel preaching and the duty of sinners to believe; useful for evangelism preaching and Baptist theology.

title: The Gospel Its Own Witness
author: Andrew Fuller
recommended_use: A Baptist apologetic work defending the internal evidence and moral excellence of Christianity.

title: Dialogues Letters and Essays on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
recommended_use: A collection of Fuller essays and letters useful for doctrinal study Baptist history and pastoral reflection.

title: Memoir of Rev. Samuel Pearce A.M.
author: Andrew Fuller
recommended_use: A missionary-era Baptist biography connected to the Carey circle; useful for missions inspiration and Baptist history.

title: The Atonement of Christ
author: Andrew Fuller
recommended_use: A Baptist theological work on the atonement; useful for careful doctrinal study and preaching preparation.
